services.name: US Sailing Basic Keelboat
services.desc: comprehensive learn-to-sail certification course will take you from a complete beginner to a confident skipper. In 2 full days (16 hours), you'll learn on-the-water skills as well as sailing theory, basic navigation, knot tying, and more. The Basic Keelboat graduate will have successfully demonstrated the ability to responsibly skipper and crew a simple day-sailing keelboat in familiar waters in light to moderate wind and sea conditions. Upon completion, you'll receive a US Sailing Basic Keelboat certification and free one-year membership. Includes 16 hours of instruction Course Learn to sail! • 2 days • Certification Optional

services.name: Bella Cocktail Sail
services.desc: Enjoy a Sunset Sail Aboard Bella! 2 Hours Pricing $150 per person $900 private charter About Let the captain and crew do all the work while you relax aboard our newest member of the fleet, Bella. Enjoy a Caribbean-inspired cocktail while you cruise our local waterways and watch the sunset. Bella is a 44' Lagoon catamaran, fully equipped with air conditioning and generator, sound system, grill, and many comfortable spots to relax! Enjoy all the comforts of home while out on the water. Important info Life jackets must be worn by children 12 and under. -Accommodates up to 6 Sunset Cruise • 2 Hours • Up to 6 People

services.name: ASA 104 Bareboat Cruising
services.desc: 3 Days About Join the crew aboard Zoe or Bella and sail around the famous Cape Fear Shoals. Learn about what it takes to be a blue water cruiser and bareboat charter skipper on your first offshore sail with a veteran captain. Depending on conditions, we will sail out of Masonboro inlet and make our way around the shoals overnight and enter the Cape Fear river and stop in Southport to rest up and continue the journey up the river to snows cut and into the ICW back to Wrightsville Beach. Includes 1 night as liveaboard as required for certification. Additional All Ages • 3 Day Package

services.name: Zoe Sunset Sail
services.desc: Enjoy a Sunset Sail Aboard Zoe 2 Hours Prices starting at $475 off season rate, $600 peak season About Let the captain and crew do all the work while you relax aboard our newest member of the fleet. Zoe is a state-of-the-art 2019 Jeanneau Sun Odyssey 349. Feel the wind in your hair as you cruise our local waterways watching the sunset. Accommodates up to 6 guests. services.name: Private Charter
services.desc: Enjoy a Cruise Around the local Waterways 2 Hours About The coastal waters surrounding the Blockade Runner are beautiful any time of day. Hop aboard the Carolina Runner with your crew and join us for a relaxing and scenic cruise where you have a front row seat to the best views of Wrightsville Beach. Don’t be surprised if your captain brings you to your own private beach to explore and Offseason Prices 2 Hours • up to 25 people

services.name: Sunset Harbor Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy the Sunset on the Water 1.5 Hours About The coastal waters surrounding the Blockade Runner are beautiful any time of day, but nothing compares to the views at sunset. Hop aboard the Carolina Runner and join us for a relaxing and scenic 1.5 hour cruise where you have a front row seat to the best views of Wrightsville Beach. Don’t be surprised if your captain spots dolphins, turtles, seabirds and other marine All ages • 1.5 Hours • 6 People Minimum

services.name: Try Sailing on a Hobie
services.desc: Test the Waters 1 Hour About Enjoy a 1 hour sail with one of our sailing instructors on a 14' Hobie Catamaran. Our Soundside offers calm waters and steady sea breezes, a perfect setting for a first-time sailor. We have an instructor available every day of the week, so don’t hesitate to give it a All Ages • 1 Hour

services.name: Bella Half-Day Catamaran Sail
services.desc: Sail and experience an island adventure aboard our 44' catamaran 4 Hours About Set sail aboard Bella, our 44' catamaran! On this 4hr private charter, you will sail around the waterways of Wrightsville Beach and Atlantic Ocean. You will work with your captain to plan your perfect itinerary of islands and local spots. Upon anchoring, the crew will dinghy you around wherever you'd like to go! The boat is fully equipped with air conditioning and generator, sound system, grill, and many comfortable spots to relax! Enjoy all the comforts of home while out on the water. Explore the "WBVIs!" All Ages • 4 Hours • Up to Six People

services.name: Masonboro Adventure Sail
services.desc: Set Sail and Explore Masonboro Island 3 Hours About Help raise the sails aboard ‘Zoe’, the newest addition to the Soundside fleet. On this three-hour sailing adventure you will sail past the south end of Wrightsville Beach and through Masonboro Inlet to the Atlantic Ocean. After experiencing the thrill of sailing in the ocean, we’ll anchor behind Masonboro Island, North Carolina’s largest undisturbed barrier island, for some exploration and relaxation. Required Life jackets must be worn by children 12 and under. Accommodates up to 6 All Ages • 3 Hours • Up to Six People

services.name: Bella Brunch Cruise
services.desc: Join our happy crew as the sun warms and the wind picks up, relax and cruise through our local waterways. Wake-up slow, have a bite and the best sip of coffee aboard Bella.
